about.title: About me
about.text: I enjoy the interface as much as the logic that holds it up.
about.study: Graduate in cross-platform (DAM) and web (DAW) application development. Codex was my final project.
about.work: Vue, React and Node.js, REST APIs and microservices, and MySQL, PostgreSQL or MongoDB. I deploy with Docker and GitHub Actions.
about.also: I built the Casulab site during my internship and have made Unity games, with Mirror multiplayer and Steamworks integration.

projects.casulab_desc: Corporate website for a scientific equipment company in Terrassa, built as a team with a colleague during my internship.
projects.synapse_desc: Collaborative planner with work, education, personal and shared calendars, and real-time notifications.
projects.optica_desc: Website for an optician in Zaragoza, with a minimalist design, interactive animations, appointment requests and an email contact form.
projects.codex_desc: A social network for students, with posts, real-time messages, video calls and a space for each school. My DAW final project, built in a team of four.
projects.casulab_problem: The corporate site of a scientific equipment company in Terrassa. It brings together its three divisions, Enterlab, Rephile and Casulab, with their services and ways to get in touch.
projects.casulab_did: I built it in a team with a fellow intern during my internship.
projects.synapse_problem: An ordinary calendar treats an exam and a dinner the same way. Synapse separates work, education, personal and shared agendas, each with its own rules: in work agendas, for instance, events can need approval.
projects.synapse_did: A solo project: the React interface, the API with Express and Prisma, the PostgreSQL database and the deployment on Vercel, Render and Neon.
projects.synapse_hard: Importing a whole Google Calendar took so long that the server answered with a 502 error. I moved the import to the background and added on-screen progress.
projects.synapse_state: Online and in development. It is a demo: use test data only, and the first load can take up to a minute.
projects.optica_problem: The site of an optician in Zaragoza, open since 1985. It shows its services and collections and takes appointment requests.
projects.optica_did: The whole site: interface with Next.js and TypeScript, animations with Framer Motion and Rive, and the appointment form.
projects.optica_hard: Emailing the appointments without an outside service. A Next.js server route talks to the mail server over SMTP, so the credentials never reach the browser.
projects.codex_problem: A social network for students: post questions with code, follow people, talk in real time and have a private space for each school. It was my DAW final project.
projects.codex_did: In a team of four, I built most of the Laravel API (posts, Google sign-in, search, schools and notifications) and the deployment with Docker and GitHub Actions. I also worked on the interface.
projects.codex_hard: Getting notifications to arrive instantly. The Laravel API publishes them to Redis and a separate Socket.io server delivers them to each connected user.
projects.codex_state: The code is public. The online version is being prepared.
